hero.name: Devendra Kumar
summary: Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience delivering enterprise-grade applications in finance, fitness, and event management.
I build scalable full-stack systems using React, Angular, Node.js, Next.js, modern databases, and AWS with strong focus on architecture, performance, and delivery.

about.title: About Me
paragraphs: Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade web platforms across finance, fitness, and event management.
I build scalable and maintainable full-stack solutions with React.js, Angular, Node.js, Express.js, Next.js, and cloud-native AWS services, including real-time systems and API-heavy products.
I lead architecture, code quality, and Agile delivery with strong ownership, mentorship, and a product-first engineering mindset.

milestones.info: Started with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Linux, Java, Servlet, and JSP.
Joined GSS Pvt. Ltd.; built enterprise modules with Java, Spring, Angular, and Node.js.
Joined OakNorth Global Pvt. Ltd.; delivered full-stack features with React, Node.js, APIs, and SQL.
Joined HDOR Events Pvt. Ltd. and progressed into team leadership on multi-platform products.

items.company: HDOR Events Pvt. Ltd., New Delhi, India
items.period: Feb 2023 - Nov 2025 (HDOR payroll: Feb 2023 - Mar 2024; Gateway Software Solutions payroll: Apr 2024 - Nov 2025)
highlights: Built from scratch a multi-portal ecosystem (User, Registration, Activity, Authentication, Admin, Organiser) for large-scale virtual events.
Led frontend development of Procam Registration and Admin Portals using Angular 13 and Angular 17.
Owned frontend architecture, UI implementation, and Agile delivery with focus on scalability, security, and timely releases.
Enabled tracking and analytics across portals with Google Analytics, GTM, WebEngage, and Facebook Pixel.
Developed a reusable Ads SDK (plug-and-play) for dynamic ad serving using HTML tag id and data attributes.
Designed personalized video generation pipeline using Node.js and Remotion, automated with AWS SQS and SES.
Built Node.js utilities for certificate generation, reporting, and workflow automation.
Implemented Redux, TanStack Query, and Recharts/D3 for state, caching, dashboards, and infographics.
Built a custom Pub/Sub event bus for React applications to handle cross-component communication.
Optimized bundle size using Webpack Analyzer and Rollup Plugin Visualizer.
Led code reviews, mentoring, and task management for quality and timely delivery.
Deployed frontend on AWS S3 + CloudFront and backend services on Linux + NGINX reverse proxy.
Managed delivery workflows with Git, JIRA, and Confluence.

items.company: OakNorth Global Pvt. Ltd., Gurugram, India
highlights: Contributed to financial and banking applications combining React/Angular frontends with Node.js APIs.
Rate Change Communication: Enabled product rate change communication with approval workflows and live tracking using Angular, Express.js, MySQL, Socket.io, and AWS SES.
Rate Change Automation: Built an automated system from scratch to validate and execute account rate changes with rollback support using Angular, Express.js, MySQL, and Socket.io.
Hubspot to Mambu Email Upload: Built a system from scratch to automate email uploads using CSV and HTML templates with dynamic placeholders using Angular, Express.js, MySQL, and Socket.io.
Collateral Search: Integrated Google Maps APIs to visualize loan collaterals and built React frontend with Node.js backend from scratch using geolocation and radius search.
Retail Deposit Journey: Contributed to account onboarding and investment portal, adding features and maintaining a scalable React.js frontend.
Contributed to internal React.js UI library by building reusable components with Styled Components and documenting them in Storybook.
Containerized Node.js and Angular apps into Docker images for deployment consistency.
Used AWS SES for reliable email delivery and AWS CloudWatch for monitoring, logging, and performance tracking.

items.company: Gateway Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd., New Delhi, India
highlights: Developed fitness and virtual event platforms from scratch (HDOR, TDH, Runners Club, NEB Sports, Virtual Races) using Angular, Angular Material, Bootstrap, and custom CSS, integrating payment gateways, multi-language support, Google Maps/Charts, and admin dashboards.
Runners Club (Romanian client): Delivered a localized version of HDOR with multi-language support and Google Maps integration.
NEB Sports (client similar to Procam): Built event platforms with admin dashboards and participant management tools.

Delivered Procam Registration and Admin Portals from scratch for physical event management, implementing registration workflows, dashboards, and participant statistics with Angular and Angular Material.
Maintained and enhanced the E-Compliance Suite (LCM-FCM, DMS, Phase and Event) using Java Spring and Hibernate, improving compliance management and scheduling workflows.
Built multiple admin dashboards from scratch for event moderation, reporting, and user management with Angular, Angular Material, Bootstrap, and custom CSS.
Started as a solo developer on HDOR event platforms and grew into a team lead managing three frontend developers, driving delivery and mentoring juniors.
Deployed Java Spring applications on Linux servers with Apache Tomcat, ensuring reliable backend operations.
Deployed frontend applications using AWS S3 (static hosting) and CloudFront (CDN) for high availability and global distribution.
